products.descriptionEs: Los más comunes son: combo italiano - salami, pepperoni, capicola y queso provolone, con lechuga y tomate; y combo americano - rosbif, pavo, jamón y queso americano, con lechuga y tomate. Los subs para fiesta vienen en tamaños de 3, 4, 5 y 6 pies. Un sub de tres pies alimenta a 10-14 personas. Un sub de seis pies alimenta a 22-28 personas. Hechos con carnes frías marca Boar's Head.
products.descriptionEn: Most common types are: Italian Combo - Salami, Pepperoni, Cappicola and Provolone cheese, with lettuce and tomato, and the American Combo – Roast Beef, Turkey, Ham and American cheese, with lettuce and tomato. Party Subs come in sizes 3, 4, 5 and 6 feet. Three foot sub will feed 10-14 people. Six foot sub will feed 22-28 people. Made with Boar's Head brand deli meats.
